notes:
Inbound SMB lead — self-serve signup, small paid trial. CTO (Mark H.) is primary technical contact. They built a chat widget that outsources LLM calls to our hosted API. Current ask: streaming + function/tool-calls with strict JSON outputs for downstream parsers. 

Problem summary: intermittently receiving malformed JSON chunks during streaming mode; function call schema sometimes rejected by downstream runtime (expects object with "action" (string) + "args" (object)). Observed symptoms: 
- client receives chunked stream that ends mid-object -> JSON.parse failure on client side
- when using function schema, assistant returns a quoted JSON string instead of calling function (i.e., not using function call envelope)
- inconsistent Content-Type headers in their proxy causing some clients to concat chunks incorrectly

Customer quotes: "Works 70% of the time, but when it fails our frontend crashes and we lose user context". They tried toggling "json_mode" flags and different max_tokens; no clear correlation. 

Initial triage done by SE: verified sample convo reproduces malformed chunk when using our JS streaming SDK with small chunk_size param. Repro not yet deterministic — appears tied to prompt length and trailing punctuation. Also saw one instance of model returning a stringified JSON (escape sequences) instead of structured payload; suspect prompt/templates not enforcing function call. 

Requested from customer: minimal reproducible script, server-side proxy logs (showing chunk boundaries), latest Fireflies transcript (ff_20260228_1130). We provided docs link to streaming best-practices and function schema examples and a short checklist: enforce function definition, use response_mode: "function_call", validate Content-Type streaming, increase keepalive timeout. 

Notes on risk/fit: Good PLG fit — technical buyer, low budget sensitivity but needs reliability. Likely 1-2k/mo if stable. Wants hosted API (public cloud). Could expand to Optimize later for structured-output QA.

Sales tenor: keep light-touch. AE to secure repro, SE to reproduce and propose quick config change. If repro holds, recommend canary fix in their environment + fallback to non-streaming until resolved.
